title: Macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's eye condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for vision changes.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y/o female presenting for scheduled management of exudative age-related macular degeneration of the right eye. Pt reports stable vision but continues to monitor for fluctuations. Reviewed hx of vision loss and previous treatments.

Medication List
Current medications not specified.

Exam
Right eye: Fundus exam reveals active choroidal neovascularization. Dilated fundus exam shows significant subretinal fluid. Visual acuity remains stable for today's visit.

Assessment
1. Exudative age-related macular degeneration of the right eye with active CNV.

Plan
1. Administered anti-VEGF injection to the right eye today.
2. Pt to monitor for any sudden changes in vision.
3. F/u in appropriate timeframe for next injection and monitoring of active CNV.

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: Exudative (wet) AMD, right eye, with active choroidal neovascularization: H35.3211 (HCC 300).

distractors.why: Wet (exudative) AMD is documented; dry AMD has no HCC.
The neovascularization is documented as active.
